title: Opening Night at the Aurora Orbital Hotel

docking.title: Act 1 — The VIP Shuttle
docking.briefing: The VIP shuttle is approaching with nearly empty tanks. Open exactly one docking gate that leads safely to the ballroom.

facts.prompt: Gate A is pressurised all the way to the ballroom.
Gate C is pressurised all the way to the ballroom.

Navigator.text: Gate A reaches the ballroom along the BLUE route.
Gate C reaches the ballroom along the YELLOW route. Gate B only reaches the cargo hold.

Decoder.text: Status glyphs: ◇ means pressurised, ✕ means venting.
Blue routes invert after an overload: a ◇ on a blue route actually means ✕.

Operator.text: Panel note: the shuttle only has fuel for ONE gate attempt.

Auditor.text: Maintenance log: the blue routes overloaded four minutes ago.

Dispatcher.text: Status board: Gate A ◇, Gate B ✕, Gate C ◇.

actions.label: Open Gate A
actions.narration: Gate A vents! The VIPs arrive windswept and furious.

actions.label: Open Gate B
actions.narration: The VIPs are delivered to the cargo hold, between two crates of napkins.

actions.label: Open Gate C
actions.narration: A smooth docking. The VIPs glide into the ballroom.

timeout.narration: Nobody opened a gate. The shuttle circles until a tug drags it in.

power.title: Act 2 — The Power Reroute
power.briefing: The ceremony needs extra power. Reroute it to one deck — but choose carefully, the hotel will remember.

facts.prompt: Line 3 is at its capacity limit.
The Spa is fed by Line 1.

Navigator.text: Line 1 feeds the Observatory. Line 2 feeds the Kitchens. Line 3 feeds the Spa.

Decoder.text: Capacity glyphs: ▲ means spare capacity, ▼ means at its limit.

Operator.text: Panel warning: rerouting into a line at its limit trips the breaker for the whole deck.

Auditor.text: Incident history: Line 3 tripped during last week's rehearsal.

Dispatcher.text: Rumour from the crew: whoever gets power tonight gets the spotlight in the finale.

actions.label: Reroute to the Observatory
actions.narration: The great telescope hums to life. The repair bay dims to make room.

actions.label: Reroute to the Kitchens
actions.narration: The robot chef wakes up and starts reading the menu very literally.

actions.label: Reroute to the Spa
actions.narration: The breaker trips. The Spa deck goes dark mid-massage. The kitchens limp on emergency power.

timeout.narration: Power drifts to the kitchens by default.

finale_observatory.title: Finale — Fireworks from the Observatory
finale_observatory.briefing: The opening fireworks must launch through the right observatory window. There is only one launch.

facts.prompt: Earth is currently in eclipse shadow.
The East window faces the Moon.

Navigator.text: Windows: North faces Earth, East faces the Moon, West faces empty space.

Decoder.text: Ceremony tradition: fireworks are launched toward the brightest object in view.

Operator.text: Launch controls lock to a single window per ceremony.

Auditor.text: Telescope feed (powered tonight): Earth is in eclipse shadow for the next hour.

Dispatcher.text: Brightness board: Moon — FULL. Earth — normally brightest, check the telescope.

actions.label: Launch through the North window
actions.narration: The fireworks vanish into Earth's shadow. Polite applause.

actions.label: Launch through the East window
actions.narration: Fireworks bloom against the full Moon. The guests gasp.

actions.label: Launch through the West window
actions.narration: A dazzling display, witnessed by absolutely nobody.

timeout.narration: The fireworks fizzle on the launch rail.

finale_kitchens.title: Finale — The Literal Robot Chef
finale_kitchens.briefing: The robot chef interprets dish cards as engineering instructions. Load the one card that serves the first course safely.

facts.prompt: The first course must be served warm.

Navigator.text: The chef's arm reaches stations in order: Grill, Oven, Freezer.

Decoder.text: Menu glyphs: ♨ means heat, ❄ means chill, ⟳ means repeat the previous step.
Banquet etiquette: the first course must be served warm.

Operator.text: The chef accepts exactly one dish card for the first course.

Auditor.text: Safety log: the grill sprinkler is disabled for maintenance tonight.

Dispatcher.text: Dish cards: Soufflé = Oven ♨ ⟳. Sorbet = Freezer ❄ ⟳. Flambé = Grill ♨ ♨ ♨.

actions.label: Load the Soufflé card
actions.narration: A perfectly risen soufflé. The chef bows.

actions.label: Load the Sorbet card
actions.narration: The guests receive a frozen first course and very cold looks.

actions.label: Load the Flambé card
actions.narration: The grill erupts. With no sprinkler, the banquet moves to the corridor.

timeout.narration: The chef waits patiently. So do the hungry guests.
